node.statement: Non-existence of the completion. Any rank-three exact signed idempotent P realizing the pinned display would, by 1.4 and 1.5, possess an admissible z-row satisfying both constraints; since no such z-row exists, no such P exists.
node.inference: modus_tollens (a required admissible z-row is impossible)
